question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
-- Final query: Get the single row with the largest month-over-month change
WITH top10 AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid
  FROM payment p
  JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
  ORDER BY total_paid DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
monthly_totals AS (
  SELECT p.customer_id,
         date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) AS payment_month,
         SUM(p.amount) AS monthly_sum
  FROM payment p
  JOIN top10 t ON p.customer_id = t.customer_id
  GROUP BY p.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT mt.customer_id, mt.payment_month, mt.monthly_sum,
         LAG(mt.monthly_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY mt.customer_id ORDER BY mt.payment_month) AS prev_month_sum
  FROM monthly_totals mt
)
SELECT wl.customer_id, t10.first_name, t10.last_name, wl.payment_month,
       ROUND(wl.monthly_sum - wl.prev_month_sum, 2) AS mom_diff
FROM with_lag wl
JOIN top10 t10 ON wl.customer_id = t10.customer_id
WHERE wl.prev_month_sum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(mom_diff) DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM with_lag wl
JOIN top10 t10 ON wl.customer_id = t10.customer_id
WHERE wl.prev_month_sum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(mom_diff) DESC
